notes: A video size is now checked before it is shown. The picture opens on the sharpest size this source will actually serve, so a size that would come up blank is never put on the screen.

Every size but 360p used to come up empty. When the size asked for is not served here, the picture lands on the sharpest size that does open and names the one that did not - in the footer and in the size list.
A film larger than the in-memory reader can hold is no longer read and thrown away: that path reported it as "the video came back empty" while the picture was there all along.
The size list says which sizes this source would not serve on this phone, so a size marked did not play here is never a mystery.
